Subject: Fwd: Zip invite — assertion attribute mismatch (internal)

Forwarding Elliot’s note with attachments. Quick findings from my side after a first-pass:

- The screenshot suggests the accept page rendered but client-side JS didn’t find the expected 'org_claim' in the parsed SAML payload and short-circuited rendering the accept form. That matches an undefined guard in the frontend.
- The saml-response.txt shows org_id is present but the attribute name is 'organization' (vendor IdP uses org conventions) while our mapping expects 'org_id' or 'x-org-id'. So it's a mapping mismatch.

Immediate actions I recommend:
1) Priyom, can you confirm whether the portal has a fallback for alternate attribute names and if we can add a temporary mapping rule (organization -> org_id) for Novaparts?
2) Kim, if you can provide the vendor email used in invite I can manually map the tenant so Elliot can accept.

Workaround details for vendor: perform an incognito browser session + clear cookies then re-click invite after we push mapping; sometimes stale cookies change flows. But this looks mapping-related.

—Ben

Elliot — I've applied the rule for the Novaparts issuer (entityID: https://novaparts.okta.com) and cleared the cache for the accept page CDN path. Please try the invite link again in an incognito window. If that still fails, I can manually set the vendor claim to the supplied email: elliot.moreno@novaparts.com so you can complete onboarding immediately.

Note: I added a short-lived audit log entry and created ticket ZD-43219 for follow-up to add permanent normalization in the next sprint.

- Priyom
